name: Forbidden Passion
source: Experience the story of a young man who's been kicked out of his house and now has to manage this chaotic life, while having to take care of the woman and people he loves the most. Will he succumb to his condition and bad situation or will he rise up to the challenge? The choice is yours and yours alone.
translation: 体验一个被赶出家门的年轻人的故事，他现在必须管理这种混乱的生活，同时必须照顾他最爱的女人和人。他会屈服于自己的状况和糟糕的处境，还是会奋起迎接挑战？选择权是你的，也只有你自己。
